workflow.selector_prompt: Examine the task and select the workflow template that best fits. If unsure, use 'feature' for new behavior, 'fix' for bugs, 'refactor' for cleanup, or 'chore' for maintenance.

templates.label: Feature
templates.description: New capability with full BDD/TDD Red-Green-Refactor cycle, code review, and merge.
templates.when_to_use: Use for any new user-facing or system-facing behavior, new commands, new tools, or substantial extensions.

steps.label: Update Scenarios / Add new features
steps.guidance: Start by updating feature coverage and task-facing scenarios. Identify acceptance criteria.

steps.label: Write/update unit tests (run a quick smoke check; full suite runs on push)
steps.guidance: Write or update the unit tests for the change. Run a quick targeted smoke check to confirm they compile.

steps.label: Ensure new/modified tests FAIL (RED) — quick targeted run only, not full suite
steps.guidance: Run only the new/modified tests to confirm they fail before any implementation.

steps.label: Implement code (GREEN)
steps.guidance: Write the minimum code needed to satisfy the failing tests. Do NOT worry about the size of a change — implement it in full.

steps.label: Push (pre-push hook will run tests and linting)
Despatch sub agents in parallel as reviewers (Architecture, Security and Performance)
steps.guidance: Use the subagent tool in parallel mode to dispatch architecture-reviewer, security-reviewer, and performance-reviewer.

steps.label: Reply to the reviewers comments on the PR and mark resolved (use graphql)
steps.guidance: Reply to every review comment on the PR, then resolve the threads using GraphQL mutations.

steps.label: Move to local master and pull

templates.label: Fix
templates.description: Bug fix with reproduction test, targeted regression coverage, and review.
templates.when_to_use: Use when behavior is broken and needs reproduction plus repair.

steps.label: Capture reproduction / failing scenario
steps.guidance: Start by reproducing the bug in a scenario or focused test.

steps.label: Despatch reviewers (Arch, Security, Perf)
steps.guidance: Use the subagent tool to dispatch all three reviewers in parallel.

steps.label: Reply to comments and mark resolved
Move to local master and pull

guards.message: Complete reproduction, fix, and verification before committing.

templates.label: Refactor
templates.description: Internal cleanup without intended behavioral change, with safety net verification.
templates.when_to_use: Use for structural cleanup, performance improvement, or design improvement with no user-visible change.

steps.label: Define safety net tests
steps.guidance: Identify the tests that must stay green throughout the refactor.

steps.label: Re-run safety net — ensure no regressions
Move to local master and pull

guards.message: Complete the refactor safety net verification before committing.

templates.label: Docs
templates.description: Documentation-only changes such as guides, READMEs, reference docs, or examples.
templates.when_to_use: Use when the change is limited to documentation and does not alter runtime behavior.

steps.label: Clarify the documentation task
steps.guidance: Restate the docs change, target audience, and any accuracy checks needed.

steps.label: Review for clarity, accuracy, and broken references
Move to local master and pull

guards.message: Review the documentation update before committing.

templates.label: Chore
templates.description: Routine maintenance, dependency updates, CI config, or configuration work.
templates.when_to_use: Use for dependency bumps, CI pipeline changes, config updates, or any non-behavioral maintenance.

steps.label: Clarify the maintenance task
steps.guidance: Restate the task and identify any required validation.

steps.label: Move to local master and pull

guards.message: Verify the maintenance change before committing.
